mapper.select: SELECT L.LEGID AS legId, L.POINTID AS pointId, L.AMOUNT AS amount, L.TYPE AS type, L.NOTE AS note, L.ORDERNO AS orderNo, L.EARNEDAT AS earnedAt, L.EXPIREDAT AS expiredAt FROM TB_POINT_LEDGER L JOIN TB_POINT P ON L.POINTID = P.POINTID WHERE P.MEMID = #{memId} ORDER BY L.EARNEDAT DESC

SELECT L.LEGID AS legId, L.POINTID AS pointId, L.AMOUNT AS amount, L.TYPE AS type, L.NOTE AS note, L.ORDERNO AS orderNo, L.EARNEDAT AS earnedAt, L.EXPIREDAT AS expiredAt
ORDER BY L.EARNEDAT DESC, L.LEGID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT NVL(SUM(L.AMOUNT), 0) FROM TB_POINT_LEDGER L JOIN TB_POINT P ON L.POINTID = P.POINTID WHERE P.MEMID = #{memId} AND L.AMOUNT > 0 AND L.EXPIREDAT IS NOT NULL AND L.EXPIREDAT BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}

SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_POINT_LEDGER L JOIN TB_POINT P ON L.POINTID = P.POINTID WHERE P.MEMID = #{memId} AND L.AMOUNT > 0 AND L.EXPIREDAT IS NOT NULL AND L.EXPIREDAT BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}
